findings: 2019-01-15 is an executed commercial-service opening at the new Región de Murcia/Corvera airport: Aena reported the first Ryanair arrival at 10:25 on that day.

Aena's 2019-07-12 retrospective separates 21,559 Murcia-San Javier passengers in the first 14 days of January from the new airport beginning service on January 15. This is a commercial-service boundary, not closure of the military aerodrome.

The 2019-08-01 parliamentary publication explicitly associates the new airport with IATA RMU / ICAO LEMI and San Javier with MJV / LELC. The two physical airports have different code pairs; this is a replacement case, not evidence that MJV or LELC transferred to Corvera.

The parliamentary text is an explanatory statement in a non-law proposition, not an IATA/ICAO allocation instrument. It confirms a dated observation of code-to-name pairs but gives no assignment effective date.

All three saved ENAIRE 2018-12 URL attempts are HTTP 404 IIS pages; none is an AD 2, AIRAC cover, login-protected original, or historical code evidence. They were replayed and rejected. No current AIP date was substituted for a 2018/2019 assignment boundary.

findings: Historical Ministry report issued 2017-04-05 states Narvik lufthamn, Framnes was closed 2017-03-31 (PDF p.13). This confirms an airport closure fact; it does not prove NVK or ENNK allocation cancellation on that date.

The 2012 proposition is the contemporaneous plan: closure tied to Hålogaland bridge completion, or no later than the Narvik–Bodø public-service route contract expiry on 2017-03-31 if approval could be extended. It also describes then-current technical/operational approval as valid to 2016-12-01. These are planned/approval dates, not actual code expiry. The later 2017 report confirms the realised closure separately.
Narvik Framnes and Harstad/Narvik Evenes are distinct named facilities in the 2012 original. A regional service substitution must not become a physical-airport merger or code transfer.
PDF two-column layout interleaves an unrelated heading into the p.13 sentence; two exact short spans are cited rather than silently repairing extracted text.
